value.rationale: The natural quartic polynomial chirp has a sharp arithmetic CAZAC/non-CAZAC dichotomy, and the exact ambiguity-zero set determines the complex Gabor tomography rank for infinitely many prime-square dimensions. This new stationary-phase phenomenon is qualitatively different from quadratic and cubic cases, and the exact frequencies are mathematically motivated by finite time-frequency analysis.
